about: Hand-checked from company filings, company pages and named news reports, 27 Nov 2026. Company-reported figures are labeled. A dash means the company has not published it.

companies.name: Tesla Robotaxi
companies.blurb: The benchmark. Camera-only AI driving, its own app, and Cybercab now carrying public riders. This whole site tracks it city by city.

approach.t: AI driving on cameras only, no lidar, no radar, no HD maps

scale.t: Tesla doesn't publish a Robotaxi fleet count or ride numbers.

hardware.t: Model Y, plus Cybercab (no steering wheel or pedals) in Austin and Dallas

milestones.title: Cybercab public rides reach Dallas
milestones.text: The steering-wheel-free Cybercab starts carrying public riders in Dallas, after Austin in September.

milestones.title: Robotaxi launches in San Antonio
milestones.text: Tesla's biggest launch zone yet, about 274 sq mi.

milestones.title: Unsupervised rides in Fort Worth
milestones.text: Fort Worth joins Dallas as a live Robotaxi market.

companies.name: Waymo
companies.blurb: The scale leader in the US. Fully driverless paid rides in 15 US cities, now rolling out its own Ojai vehicle. Freeway rides are paused for now.

approach.t: Lidar + imaging radar + high-res cameras fused, 6th-gen Waymo Driver

status.t: Fully driverless paid rides. Freeway rides suspended nationwide since mid Nov 2026 after a California DMV order.

markets.t: 15 US cities live. Up next abroad: London, Tokyo, Munich, Madrid region, Toronto, Singapore.

scale.t: 500,000+ paid trips a week and 4,000+ vehicles (company figures)

hardware.t: Jaguar I-PACE and the Zeekr-built Ojai (first with the 6th-gen Driver)

specs.v: Lidar, imaging radar, 17 MP cameras, external audio

milestones.title: Freeway rides paused nationwide
milestones.text: After a California DMV restriction issued 11 Nov, Waymo stopped freeway trips in every market while it evaluates performance. Surface-street service continues.

milestones.title: Mapping Tampa International Airport
milestones.text: First step toward airport service in Tampa. Waymo cites 4,000+ vehicles and 500,000+ paid trips a week.

milestones.title: First public riders in the Ojai
milestones.text: Select riders in SF, Phoenix and LA get free Ojai rides, with Denver, Las Vegas and San Diego next.

companies.name: Zoox
companies.blurb: The only purpose-built, no-steering-wheel robotaxi charging fares in the US. Paid rides in Las Vegas only, everything else is still free or employees-only.

approach.t: Purpose-built bidirectional robotaxi, no steering wheel or pedals, 4 seats facing each other

status.t: Paid public rides in Las Vegas since 10 Aug 2026. Free early-rider program in SF. Employees, family and friends only in Austin, Miami, Atlanta and LA.

markets.t: Las Vegas (paid, also on Uber), San Francisco (free), Austin, Miami, Atlanta, Los Angeles (employees)

scale.t: 1M+ riders carried (company). No official fleet count.

hardware.t: Zoox robotaxi under the first NHTSA commercial exemption (up to 2,500 vehicles a year, through 31 Jul 2028)

milestones.title: Robotaxis start driving in Los Angeles
milestones.text: Santa Monica first, employees and friends only. Atlanta started 13 Nov. Public waitlists come later.

milestones.title: Zoox shows up in the Uber app in Las Vegas
milestones.text: Uber riders can be matched with a Zoox on eligible trips, starting with a small fleet.

milestones.title: Vegas service grows beyond the Strip
milestones.text: Downtown and the Arts District added, hours extended to 6 a.m. to 3 a.m., redesigned vehicle debuts.

companies.name: May Mobility
companies.blurb: Small-scale and partner-first. Rides on Lyft in Atlanta with a standby operator, a few driver-out sites, and a big ID. Buzz plan for later.

approach.t: On-vehicle world model plus real-time reasoning, sold as autonomy-as-a-service to fleet partners

status.t: Commercial service, mostly with standby operators. Three driver-out deployments to date (company).

markets.t: Atlanta (Lyft), Eden Prairie and Grand Rapids MN, Ann Arbor (invite only). Arlington TX with Uber targeted for 2027. Pilot in Nagoya, Japan.

scale.t: 600,000+ commercial autonomous rides, 1.1M miles in the US and Japan (company)

hardware.t: Toyota Sienna AVs today. VW ID. Buzz from 2028, targeting 10,000+ through 2031 (company target)

specs.v: Lyft, standby operator on every ride

milestones.title: CEO: Arlington goes driver-out around the new year
milestones.text: Edwin Olson says Arlington TX will be the fourth driver-out deployment, and the public listing likely slips into January.

milestones.title: Volkswagen ID. Buzz picked as the scale vehicle
milestones.text: Targets 10,000+ autonomous ID. Buzz through 2031, US road testing in early 2027.

companies.name: Baidu Apollo Go
companies.blurb: China's biggest robotaxi network, now in 30 cities and pushing into Dubai, London, Hong Kong and Switzerland.

approach.t: Lidar + cameras L4 stack on purpose-built vehicles (38 sensors on the RT6)

status.t: Fully driverless commercial rides in China and Dubai. Testing in London (with Uber and Lyft) and on Hong Kong's Airport Island.

scale.t: 390M+ autonomous km total by 31 Oct 2026, about 34M km in Q3 (company, unaudited)

hardware.t: Apollo RT6: detachable steering wheel, 38 sensors incl. 8 lidars and 12 cameras, 1,200 TOPS

milestones.title: Q3: 30 cities, Dubai fleet doubled
milestones.text: Shenzhen fully driverless rides up about 170% quarter over quarter. No ride count or fleet size given.

milestones.title: Swiss nod with PostBus
milestones.text: Regulators clear Apollo Go and PostBus for a robotaxi service in eastern Switzerland.

companies.name: WeRide
companies.blurb: Most of its robotaxi money now comes from outside China, led by fully driverless service in Abu Dhabi and Dubai on Uber.

approach.t: L4 robotaxis, robobuses and more, asset-light: WeRide supplies the tech and remote assistance, local partners fund and run fleets

status.t: Fully driverless commercial operations in Abu Dhabi and Dubai. Spain's first national L4 passenger permit.

markets.t: China, UAE, Saudi Arabia, plus Spain, Switzerland, Belgium, France and testing in Slovakia

scale.t: About 4,100 L4 vehicles incl. 2,300+ robotaxis (31 Oct 2026). Middle East robotaxi fleet about 600 (company).

specs.v: Largest Uber AV partner outside the US (company claim)

milestones.title: Q3: robotaxi revenue tops RMB 100M
milestones.text: Up 204% year over year, Guangzhou robotaxis hit positive unit economics, robotaxi fleet up 26% in the quarter.

milestones.title: Plans to roughly triple the Middle East fleet
milestones.text: CFO guides to 800 to 1,000 vehicles by end of December and about double that in 2027.

companies.name: Pony.ai
companies.blurb: Mass-producing Gen-7 robotaxis with Toyota, BAIC and GAC. Biggest single zone in Guangzhou, first driverless test rides in Europe.

approach.t: L4 Virtual Driver trained with its PonyWorld world model and reinforcement learning

status.t: Fully driverless commercial rides in China. All three Gen-7 models in driverless commercial service.

markets.t: Guangzhou, Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen and more in China. Zagreb (driverless test rides), London and Manchester in the works.

scale.t: 2,768 robotaxis on 30 Sep 2026, targeting 3,500 by year-end (company)

hardware.t: Gen-7 robotaxis built with Toyota (bZ4X), BAIC and GAC

specs.v: Driverless test rides in Zagreb since Sep 2026

milestones.title: Q3: fleet at 2,768
milestones.text: Robotaxi revenue up 165% year over year; Hangzhou, Chongqing and Hengqin deployments started.

milestones.title: Toyota bZ4X robotaxi goes fully driverless
milestones.text: Joins the paid driverless fleet in Guangzhou, 24 hours a day. About 1,000 planned across China.

companies.name: comma.ai (openpilot)
companies.blurb: The car-agnostic wildcard. A $999 windshield box running open-source openpilot that adds lane centering and adaptive cruise to hundreds of cars you already own. It's driver assistance, not a robotaxi: you stay responsible and watching.

approach.t: Open-source openpilot, end-to-end driving model (880M-parameter big model in 0.11.2). Driver assistance with an attentive driver.

status.t: On sale now. Supervised driver assistance (Level 2), driver monitoring on.

markets.t: Ships worldwide. Supported cars listed for the US market unless noted.

scale.t: 335 supported cars in the openpilot list (comma's site says 350+)

hardware.t: comma four: dual 360° cameras + narrow cam, Snapdragon 845, no lidar. Plugs in with a car-specific harness.

milestones.title: openpilot 0.11.2 ships
milestones.text: First "chestnut" driving models, an 880M-parameter big model that can run on an external GPU, better driver monitoring, and VW ID.4 as a new gold car.

milestones.title: openpilot 0.11.1
milestones.text: New driver-monitoring model; Rivian R1S/R1T 2025 and Acura MDX 2022-24 added.

milestones.title: comma four launches
milestones.text: Same compute and sensors as comma 3X in a box one-fifth the size.

companies.name: Wayve
companies.blurb: London's embodied-AI bet. A mapless, hardware-agnostic AI Driver that automakers and Uber can drop into different cars.

approach.t: End-to-end embodied AI, mapless and hardware-agnostic ("AV2.0")

status.t: Supervised robotaxi rides on Uber in London since 3 Sep 2026, licensed driver onboard

markets.t: London live (supervised). Tokyo pilot with Nissan LEAF planned. Uber deal covers 12 markets.

scale.t: "A small number of vehicles" in London. No fleet count published.

hardware.t: Ford Mustang Mach-E on Uber; Nissan next-gen ProPILOT from FY2027

specs.v: Nissan ProPILOT, first car in Japan FY2027
Works with varied setups (cameras, radar, lidar on Nissan)

milestones.title: Wayve, Stellantis and NVIDIA team up in France
milestones.text: Working with the French government on AV deployment in France and across the EU.

milestones.title: First autonomous rides in the UK, on Uber
milestones.text: UberX, Electric or Comfort riders in London can be matched with a supervised Wayve Mach-E at no extra cost.

companies.name: Mobileye
companies.blurb: The chip-and-software supplier inside millions of cars, now edging into robotaxis through VW's ID. Buzz and transit partners.

approach.t: EyeQ chips and software sold to automakers, from basic ADAS up to Mobileye Drive for robotaxis

status.t: ADAS in production at scale. Robotaxi: public ridepooling in Hamburg with safety drivers, closed-group testing in Orlando.

markets.t: Global OEM supply. Robotaxi work in Germany, the US (Orlando) and Norway (Holo permit).

scale.t: 9.5M EyeQ and SuperVision systems shipped in Q3 2026

hardware.t: EyeQ SoCs; Mobileye Drive on VW ID. Buzz (MOIA) and HOLON Urban shuttles

milestones.title: Q3: Hamburg ridepooling, Deutsche Bahn picks HOLON
milestones.text: Public autonomous ridepooling in Hamburg with safety drivers, Holo permitted in Norway, Deutsche Bahn chooses the Mobileye-driven HOLON Urban.

milestones.title: MOIA and Beep start ID. Buzz rides in Orlando
milestones.text: Invited riders in Mobileye-equipped ID. Buzz vehicles, with human operators onboard.
